svg.title: Where the mug cozy closes around the handle
svg.desc: A mug seen from above. The cozy wraps the wall and stops on either side of the handle. The body length is the distance around the mug minus the width of the handle where it meets the wall: 10 minus 1 is 9 inches. A strap from one end passes between the handle and the wall to a button on the other end. A seamed tube cannot pass the handle, which is attached to the wall at the top and the bottom.
svg.text: Body = around the mug - handle base: 10 - 1 = 9 in.
A sewn tube cannot get past the handle.
The handle is fixed to the wall at top and bottom.
